name: expense-approval-system
description: Full-stack Expense Approval System with React, Vite, Express, Prisma ORM

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix server run db:push && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
